opinions.text: Ct. App. Cal., 1st App. Dist. [Certiorari granted, 449 U. S. 1109.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for additional time for oral argument granted, and 10 additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Petitioner also allotted an additional 10 minutes for oral argument. Motion of petitioner for divided argument denied.
